subject: Smoothing the hotspots in Predicted Map

messages.author: 96e275f43eafb053
messages.subject: Smoothing the hotspots in Predicted Map
parts:
Hi All,

I used the following code to create mesh, but the predicted mean map is not smooth in hotspots i.e has vertex corners as can be observed in the attached.

Is it possible to modify mesh inorder to achieve a smoother map. My model was AR2

mesh.dummy=inla.mesh.create(loc=borders,extend=list(n=10, offset=0.7),refine=FALSE)
boundary = inla.mesh.boundary(mesh.dummy)
mesh = inla.mesh.create(boundary=boundary,
                        refine=list(max.edge=0.5))
nmesh = mesh$n;nmesh
mesh.idx = mesh$idx$loc
plot(mesh)
lines(borders,lwd=3)
points(coordinates$Long,coordinates$Lat,pch=20,cex=2, col="blue")
points(coordinates.val$Long,coordinates.val$Lat,pch=20,cex=2, col="red")
points(boundary[[1]]$loc,col=3,cex=3,pch=20)


# ################################
## Make the SPDE object and the formula
## ################################

spde=inla.spde2.matern(mesh=mesh, alpha=2)

A.est=inla.spde.make.A(mesh,loc=as.matrix(coordinates[civ.data$Cluster_ID,c("Long","Lat")]),group=civ.data$time,n.group=no.years)

A.val=inla.spde.make.A(mesh,loc=as.matrix(coordinates.val[civ.validation$Cluster_ID,c("Long","Lat")]),group=civ.validation$time,n.group=no.years)

i.year<-31

A.pred<-inla.spde.make.A(mesh, group=i.year, n.group=no.years)
field.indices <-inla.spde.make.index("field",n.spde=mesh$n,n.group=no.years)


stack.est <-inla.stack(data=list(Pf=civ.data$Pf),A=list(A.est, 1),effects=list(c(field.indices, list(Intercept=1)),list(civ.data[,4:7])),tag="est")
stack.val<-inla.stack(data=list(Pf=NA),A=list(A.val,1),effects=list(c(field.indices,list(intercept=1)),list(civ.validation[,4:7])),tag="val")

scaled.mesh.loc<-list(Long=(rep(scale(mesh$loc[,1],mean.covariates["Long"],sd.covariates["Long"]),no.years)),Lat=(rep(scale(mesh$loc[,2],mean.covariates["Lat"],sd.covariates["Lat"]),no.years)))
stack.pred<-inla.stack(data=list(Pf=NA), A=list(A.pred),effects=list(c(field.indices,scaled.mesh.loc,list(Intercept=1) )),tag="pred")

stack<-inla.stack(stack.est, stack.val,stack.pred)
str(inla.stack.data(stack.est))
str(inla.stack.data(stack.val))         
str(inla.stack.data(stack.pred))
str(inla.stack.data(stack))

formula=(Pf ~ -1 + Intercept + Long+ Lat + prec+urbanization + f(field, model = spde, group = field.group, control.group =list(model="ar",order=2)))

Hi,

I can't see any attached mesh image, but I suspect that you have too large triangles.  I that case, reduce max.edge.

Finn
